edges.reason: Constructor assigns the owner state variable directly from msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier compares the untrusted msg.sender against the stored owner.
onlyOwner modifier gates execution of transferOwnership.
transferOwnership rewrites the owner state variable with the new address.
newOwner parameter flows into the owner state variable assignment.
Token address parameter is converted and stored in the token state variable.
Constructor writes the token state variable.
batchTransfer reads the token state variable for transfers.
withdraw reads the token state variable for balance and transfer.
balanceOfContract reads the token state variable balance.
token.decimals() feeds the exponentiation computing decimalsForCalc.
Computed scaling factor is used in the batchTransfer loop.
decimalsForCalc local variable is the result of the 10**decimals arithmetic.
batchTransfer performs the amount scaling multiplication on each element.
User-supplied _tokenAmounts elements are multiplied by the scaling factor.
_investors array drives the batchTransfer recipient loop.
Loop index i iterates over the investors array in batchTransfer.
_address parameter is the destination of the withdraw token transfer.
tokenBalanceOfContract is passed as the amount to token.transfer in withdraw.
batchTransfer invokes the external token.transfer call inside its loop.
withdraw invokes the external token.transfer call with the full contract balance.
Malicious token contract can re-enter batchTransfer during token.transfer.
Malicious token contract can re-enter withdraw during token.transfer.
Scaling multiplication is delegated to SafeMath.mul overflow check.

normalization_plan.reason: Recipient array parameter only feeds the batchTransfer loop and should be merged into that function.
Amount array parameter is consumed by the scaling arithmetic unsafe operation.
Receiver parameter is only used by withdraw's transfer logic.
newOwner parameter only feeds the ownership assignment in transferOwnership.
Token address parameter is only used to initialize state in the constructor.
Loop counter is scoped to the batchTransfer iteration.
decimalsForCalc local is the direct result of the 10**decimals arithmetic.
Cached balance local is only used inside withdraw.
